note: Wyeast 3763 Roeselare — a Flanders-red/oud-bruin blend (Sacch + Brett + Lactobacillus + Pediococcus) modeled on the Rodenbach house culture; Roeselare is the Belgian town Rodenbach is in (Wyeast).

Wyeast 1098 British Ale = Whitbread 'B' strain lineage (dry, crisp English ale); grouped here as one isolate distinct from the Chico/US-05 family — keep the descriptive British Ale I name, origin = Whitbread (Wyeast/MTF).

Wyeast 1056 American Ale = the Chico strain from Sierra Nevada; the colloquial 'Chico' family (1056/US-05/WLP001) is split into isolate-groups here, so this is the Wyeast 1056 sub-isolate (Mr Malty, suregork).

Wyeast 1272 American Ale II — a nuttier/fruitier American ale strain (Anchor-lineage per common lore, less clean than Chico); no single famous brewery name, keep the classic American Ale II label (Wyeast/MTF).
Wyeast 1728 Scottish Ale — the classic malty Scottish/wee-heavy strain (widely linked to McEwan's/Scottish & Newcastle lineage); keep the Scottish Ale name (Wyeast/MTF).
Wyeast 1318 London Ale III — the famous NEIPA/hazy 'juice' strain, from a traditional London brewery (widely attributed to Boddingtons); the hazy-IPA icon (Wyeast/MTF).
Wyeast 3726 Farmhouse Ale (Belgian Saison II) — a rustic ester-forward saison strain distinct from Dupont/3724; no clear single origin brewery, keep the Saison II label (Wyeast/MTF).
Fermentis SafAle BE-134 — a highly-attenuative diastaticus saison strain widely regarded as a dry Saison-Dupont-type; Dupont is the reference origin/search term (Fermentis/MTF).
Wyeast 1007 German Ale — a crisp clean German alt/Kölsch-type ale strain; no single named brewery, keep the German Ale label (Wyeast/MTF).
Wyeast 2206 Bavarian Lager — a malty full-bodied Bavarian lager strain widely tied to the Weihenstephan lager line; keep the Bavarian Lager name (Wyeast/MTF).
Wyeast 2007 Pilsen Lager — the classic clean American-pilsner lager strain often called the 'Chico of lagers' (Anheuser-Busch/St. Louis lineage per lore); keep the Pilsen Lager label (Wyeast/MTF).
Wyeast 2124 Bohemian Lager — the Weihenstephan 34/70 workhorse lager strain (same 34/70 lineage sold as the world's most common lager yeast); origin = Weihenstephan (Wyeast/suregork).
Wyeast 1028 London Ale — a bold, mineral, higher-attenuating English ale strain (often linked to Worthington White Shield lineage); keep the London Ale label (Wyeast/MTF).

currentLabel: OYL-016 Extra Special (formerly British Ale VIII)
note: Wyeast 1968 London ESB = the Fuller's strain (super-floccy malty English ESB yeast); origin = Fuller's Brewery, London (Mr Malty/suregork).
Wyeast 2565 Kölsch — a classic Cologne Kölsch ale strain; origin = a Köln (Cologne) Kölsch brewery, the defining style yeast (Wyeast/MTF).
Wyeast 3463-PC Forbidden Fruit — the spicy phenolic Belgian wit/grand-cru strain widely tied to the Hoegaarden/Pierre Celis lineage; Hoegaarden is the reference origin (Wyeast/MTF).
Wyeast 3725-PC Bière de Garde — a malty French farmhouse/bière-de-garde strain; named for the northern-French style rather than a single brewery, keep the Bière de Garde label (Wyeast/MTF).
Wyeast 1450 Denny's Favorite 50 = BrewTek CL-50 'California Pub Brewery Ale' lineage (traced to North Coast/UC Davis); Denny's Favorite is the searched name (Homebrew Finds/MTF).
Fermentis SafAle S-04 — a fast-flocculating English ale dry yeast widely regarded as a Whitbread-lineage strain; Whitbread is the origin/search term (Fermentis/MTF).
Fermentis SafLager S-23 — a fruity/estery West-European lager strain grouped here with the '2001 Pilsner Urquell H-Strain'; Pilsner Urquell is the reference origin (Fermentis/Wyeast).
Fermentis SafAle S-33 — a low-attenuating general ale dry yeast from the historic Edme (England) lineage; Edme is the origin/search term (Fermentis/MTF).
SafLager W-34/70 = the Weihenstephan 34/70 strain, the world's most-used lager yeast; origin = Weihenstephan research brewery (Fermentis/suregork).

currentLabel: LalBrew BRY-97 American West Coast Ale
note: LalBrew BRY-97 — a clean American West Coast ale dry yeast from the Siebel Institute BRY collection; keep the BRY-97 / West Coast name, Siebel is the origin (Lallemand/MTF).
LalBrew Diamond — a clean neutral German lager dry yeast grouped with Wyeast 2308 Munich Lager (a Weihenstephan-type line); keep the Diamond/Munich label (Lallemand/Wyeast).
LalBrew NovaLager — a modern purpose-bred warm-fermenting lager hybrid (no historic brewery origin); keep the product name NovaLager (Lallemand).
LalBrew Windsor / Wyeast 1099 Whitbread Ale — a fruity low-attenuating English ale strain of the Whitbread 'B' lineage; Whitbread is the origin (Lallemand/Wyeast/MTF).
WLP001 California Ale = the White Labs Chico/Sierra Nevada isolate; split from the Wyeast-1056 group here, so it's the WLP001 sub-isolate of the colloquial Chico family (Mr Malty/suregork).
WLP002 English Ale = the Fuller's strain (White Labs' Fuller's isolate, sibling of Wyeast 1968); origin = Fuller's Brewery, London — split from the 1968 group here (Mr Malty/suregork).
WLP003 German Ale II = the '2575-PC Kölsch II' isolate, a Cologne Kölsch-type ale strain distinct from the 2565 Kölsch line; keep the Kölsch II label (White Labs/Wyeast).
WLP004 / Wyeast 1084 Irish Ale — marketed as a historic Irish stout (Guinness-reputed) strain but genetically NOT the modern Guinness culture; keep the descriptive Irish Ale label (White Labs/MTF).
WLP007 Dry English Ale — a clean, high-attenuating English ale strain with no reliably documented single brewery origin; keep the descriptive Dry English Ale label (White Labs).
WLP008 East Coast Ale ('Brewer Patriot') — a clean neutral American/cream-ale strain (Chico-adjacent but distinct); no documented single brewery origin, keep the descriptive label (White Labs).

Group lumps WLP022 Essex (Ridleys) with Wyeast 1469 West Yorkshire (Timothy Taylor / Landlord); they're close Beer1 English kin sold under different lab names — Timothy Taylor is the searched origin (suregork/MTF).
WLP023 Burton Ale = Wyeast 1275 Thames Valley — a clean balanced English pale-ale strain of the Burton/Thames Valley lineage; keep the Burton/Thames Valley label (White Labs/Wyeast).
WLP025 Southwold Ale / Wyeast 1335 — the Adnams strain from Southwold, Suffolk (the town White Labs names it after); origin = Adnams (White Labs/MTF).
WLP028 Edinburgh Ale — a malty Scottish ale strain from an Edinburgh brewery, widely tied to the McEwan's/Scottish & Newcastle lineage; Edinburgh/McEwan's is the origin (White Labs/MTF).
WLP029 German Ale/Kölsch — a classic Cologne Kölsch strain (White Labs' Kölsch isolate, close kin of the 2565 line); origin = a Köln Kölsch brewery (White Labs/MTF).

WLP033 Klassic Ale = Wyeast 1768-PC English Special Bitter — a traditional English bitter strain with no reliably documented single brewery origin; keep the descriptive Special Bitter label (White Labs/Wyeast).
LalBrew Nottingham = WLP039 East Midlands Ale — the classic clean high-attenuating English ale strain from the East Midlands/Nottingham lineage; Nottingham is the searched name (Lallemand/MTF).
WLP041 Pacific Ale = Wyeast 1332 Northwest Ale — a malty Pacific-Northwest ale strain (widely tied to BridgePort/NW brewpub lineage); keep the Pacific NW label (White Labs/Wyeast).

Group lumps WLP066 London Fog with LalBrew Verdant IPA — both London Ale III-lineage hazy-IPA strains from Verdant Brewing (UK) house culture, sold as distinct products; Verdant is the searched origin (Lallemand/White Labs/MTF).

Group lumps WLP090 San Diego Super (a clean fast Chico-adjacent San Diego strain, reputed Ballast Point) with Wyeast 1764 Pacman (Rogue) — the community treats these as DISTINCT; San Diego Super is the primary/searched name (White Labs/MTF).

WLP095 Burlington = the Conan strain from The Alchemist's Heady Topper (Vermont); the NEIPA classic, UK-origin house yeast via Vermont Pub & Brewery — Conan is the searched name (Mad Fermentationist/MTF).
WLP300 Hefeweizen = the White Labs Weihenstephan wheat isolate (sibling of 3068); the classic banana/clove hefeweizen yeast from Weihenstephan — split from the 3068 group here (White Labs/MTF).
WLP351 / Wyeast 3638 Bavarian Weizen — the clove-forward 'Muri' hefeweizen isolate (S. cerevisiae x uvarum hybrid, STA1+), distinct from the Weihenstephan 3068 line (suregork/Krogerus/MTF).
WLP380 group contains the '3068 Weihenstephan Weizen' isolate — the definitive Weihenstephan hefeweizen strain (balanced banana/clove); origin = Weihenstephan (White Labs/Wyeast/MTF).
WLP400 / Wyeast 3944 Belgian Witbier — the tart spicy wit strain widely tied to the Hoegaarden/Celis lineage; Hoegaarden is the reference origin (White Labs/Wyeast/MTF).
WLP410 Belgian Wit II — a milder/less-phenolic witbier strain than WLP400, with no reliably documented single brewery origin; keep the descriptive Belgian Wit II label (White Labs).
WLP500 / Wyeast 1214 Trappist = the Chimay strain (fruity Trappist abbey yeast); origin = Chimay Trappist brewery (Mr Malty/suregork/MTF).
WLP510 Bastogne — a dry, clean high-attenuating Belgian ale strain widely reputed as an Orval-type primary (Omega codes it 'Belgian Ale O'); Orval is the searched reference (White Labs/MTF).
WLP515 Antwerp Ale — a clean Belgian ale strain from Antwerp, widely tied to De Koninck (Omega codes it 'Belgian Ale DK'); De Koninck/Antwerp is the origin (White Labs/suregork/MTF).
WLP520 Sigmund = the Voss kveik from Sigmund Gjernes' farm in Voss, Norway — the most famous kveik; origin = Voss farmhouse (MTF Kveik registry).
WLP521 Hornindal = the Hornindal kveik (Terje Raftevold's culture) from Hornindal, Norway — a tropical/pineapple kveik blend; origin = Hornindal farmhouse (MTF Kveik registry).
WLP530 / Wyeast 3787 Trappist High Gravity = the Westmalle strain (the classic tripel/dubbel abbey yeast); origin = Westmalle Trappist brewery (Mr Malty/suregork/MTF).

WLP540 / Wyeast 1762 Abbey IV — marketed as the Rochefort strain, though genomics (Gallone/suregork) show British origin & POF-negative; Rochefort is the searched name, kept with the descriptor (suregork/MTF).

This group is the French Saison / Belle Saison isolate (3711 = WLP590 = M29 = LalBrew Belle Saison), a super-attenuating diastaticus saison; the WLP545 label is a mis-anchor — French Saison/Belle Saison is the searched name (suregork/MTF).
WLP550 / Wyeast 3522 Belgian Ardennes = the Achouffe strain (fruity/spicy Belgian ale); origin = Brasserie d'Achouffe, Ardennes (Wyeast/MTF).
WLP565 / Wyeast 3724 Belgian Saison I = the Saison Dupont strain (the classic peppery saison that stalls mid-ferment); origin = Brasserie Dupont (Mr Malty/suregork/MTF).
WLP570 / Wyeast 1388 Belgian Strong Golden = the Duvel strain (from Duvel Moortgat); the classic Belgian golden strong ale yeast — origin = Duvel Moortgat (BYO/Wyeast/MTF).
WLP644 'brux-like Trois' — originally sold as a Brett but reclassified as a POF+ Saccharomyces strain producing mango/pineapple esters; keep the well-known 'Trois' name (White Labs/MTF).
WLP802 / Wyeast 2000 Budvar = the Budweiser Budvar strain from Ceske Budejovice; the classic Czech pilsner lager yeast — origin = Budvar (White Labs/Wyeast/MTF).
WLP810 / Wyeast 2112 = the California Common / steam-beer lager strain from the Anchor Steam (San Francisco) lineage; Anchor is the reference origin (White Labs/Brulosophy/MTF).
WLP830 German Lager = a Weihenstephan 34/70-type clean workhorse lager (grouped here with Wyeast 2278 Czech Pils, a Pilsner Urquell D-strain kin); Weihenstephan 34/70 is the reference (suregork/MTF).
WLP833 German Bock — a malty full-bodied Bavarian bock/dunkel lager strain widely tied to the Ayinger lineage; Ayinger is the reference origin (White Labs/MTF).
WLP835 German X Lager — a malty low-sulfur Bavarian lager strain (White Labs describes a 'famous Bavarian monastery' source but names no brewery); keep the descriptive German X label (White Labs).
WLP838 Southern German Lager — a malty, low-sulfur balanced Bavarian lager strain with no reliably documented single brewery origin; keep the descriptive label (White Labs).
WLP845 Fast Lager — a warm-tolerant fast-fermenting lager strain (marketed for speed) with no documented single brewery origin; keep the descriptive Fast Lager label (White Labs).
WLP850 / Wyeast 2042 Danish Lager — a clean crisp Danish lager strain from the Copenhagen/Carlsberg lineage; Carlsberg is the reference origin (White Labs/Wyeast/MTF).
WLP860 Munich Helles — a malty Munich helles lager strain (reputed Augustiner-type by lore, unconfirmed); keep the descriptive Munich Helles label, note the Augustiner rumor (White Labs).
WLP920 / Wyeast 2247 Old Bavarian Lager — a malty central-European dark-lager strain with no reliably documented single brewery origin; keep the descriptive label (White Labs/Wyeast).
WLP940 Mexican Lager — a clean crisp lager strain from a Mexican brewery source (reputed Cuauhtemoc/Dos Equis lineage, unconfirmed); keep the descriptive Mexican Lager label (White Labs).
